## Platform Observability Overview
This dashboard follows the current read-only platform boundary: Prometheus scrape health, backend API responsiveness, collector-backed snapshot signals, bounded persisted sync-history evidence, one bounded readiness-support posture slice, and a small amount of honest live-versus-persisted or backend-versus-collector comparison context where those metrics already exist.

Current limits:
- `app-api` and `gnmi-collector` expose meaningful metrics today.
- Inventory, topology, policy, and bounded readiness-support freshness now surface where the backend already owns those metrics.
- Collector read-path coverage, observation age, and detail-ready gaps are visualized here as numeric observability signals; the product-facing degraded-scope summaries still belong in `app-web`.
- Collector-boundary latest fetch duration, configured timeout budget, and latest timeout or failure outcome are visualized here as observability-only signals; they explain fallback triggers but do not become product truth records or workflow meaning.
- Cross-slice posture panels show freshness, persisted sync result mix, and current topology snapshot labels where those backend metrics already exist.
- Topology partiality is now mirrored through four backend-owned cues where metrics expose them: inference posture, endpoint-pairing posture, node-participation posture, and collection posture.
- Readiness age stat panels use the same phrases as the app-web Readiness page: Evaluation sample (this response) age (bounded recomputation cadence; aligns with API `generated_at`) versus Persisted snapshot (last material change) age (last materially changed persisted snapshot; aligns with `readiness_persisted_at`). Observability-only—not interchangeable freshness claims, not dry-run verdicts, not phase-transition control.
- Same-workspace recovery posture is mirrored numerically through backend-owned platform_app_api_recovery_posture and platform_app_api_recovery_persisted_artifacts metrics; the product-facing explanation remains in app-web Overview and Platform Health.
- Comparison panels here show bounded aggregate deltas only; they are not drift engines or product truth.
- Policy operational truth remains intentionally partial even though bounded policy sync evidence now exists.
- ODL, Grafana, and Postgres exporter metrics remain future placeholders and are intentionally excluded from active panels.

panels.description: Backend-owned same-workspace recovery posture. Preserved baseline and fresh live recollection are not the same thing; the product-facing explanation remains in app-web Overview and Platform Health.
panels.title: Same-Workspace Recovery Posture

panels.description: Backend-owned persisted artifact availability for same-workspace recovery. Numeric observability only; product explanation remains in app-web.
panels.title: Recovery Persisted Artifacts

App API Average Request Duration by Endpoint

panels.description: Cross-slice gap counts plus the current topology paired-versus-single-sided link evidence split and linked-versus-isolated node participation split. Topology values remain bounded read-path observability that supports interpretation of evidence depth, not validation verdicts.
panels.title: Coverage, Pairing, Node Participation, And Detail Gaps
Persisted Sync Result Posture by Slice

panels.description: Backend-owned topology snapshot and partiality posture labels projected into Grafana for observability. These labels support interpretation but do not turn the dashboard into the product contract.
panels.title: Topology Snapshot And Partiality Labels

panels.description: Seconds since the latest Prometheus-observed bounded readiness evaluation sample (`platform_app_api_readiness_latest_evaluation_at_seconds`). Same clock as app-web **Evaluation sample (this response) age** / API `generated_at`: recomputation cadence, not a dry-run verdict. Observability-only.
panels.title: Evaluation sample (this response) age

panels.description: Seconds since the last materially changed persisted readiness snapshot (`platform_app_api_readiness_snapshot_persisted_at_seconds`). Same clock as app-web **Persisted snapshot (last material change) age** / `readiness_persisted_at`. Not interchangeable with evaluation-sample age. Observability-only.
panels.title: Persisted snapshot (last material change) age

panels.description: Backend-emitted readiness status and planning_readiness label pairs (platform_app_api_readiness_status). Observability mirror of the app-web Readiness page **Readiness Status** and **Planning Readiness** rows; bounded narrative stays on Readiness. Not a dry-run verdict.
panels.title: Readiness status & planning labels (mirror)

panels.description: Blocker category and severity counts (`platform_app_api_readiness_blockers_by_category_and_severity`). Numeric mirror of Readiness blocker lists; not a workflow, validation, or execution verdict.
panels.title: Readiness blocker posture (mirror)

panels.description: Prerequisite evidence coverage distribution (`platform_app_api_readiness_prerequisites_by_evidence_coverage`). Observability-only; explanatory copy stays on the app-web Readiness page.
panels.title: Readiness evidence coverage (mirror)
